messages:
maria: quick RFC follow-up. need a short decision on dashboard composition: server-assembled vs client tile fanout. want a pragmatic plan by EOD.

devin: leaning server-assembled. single auth check, one hop, simpler tracing and cost attribution.

liam: worried about centralizing load and cost spikes. client fanout enables progressive hydration and scoping per-tile cost.

sasha: suggest hybrid: server composes common/small tiles, client fetches heavy/rare tiles. return a lightweight render-plan with metadata so client knows which tiles to lazy-load.

maria: good. two technical concerns: 1) auth metadata without leaking secrets, 2) SLO protection when composing many tiles.

devin: auth: return capability tags (identifiers) not tokens; client mints short-lived capabilities from control-plane when needed. keeps audit centralized.

liam: SLOs: executor enforces a weight budget per dashboard request. tiles report weight_estimate; if budget exhausted return placeholders and a Retry-After or partial stream. emit weight_overflow metric.

sasha: sketch of render-plan (JSON sample): {"tiles":[{"id":"t1","ready":true,"weight_estimate":8},{"id":"t_big","ready":false,"capability_tag":"perm:view_big","weight_estimate":120}],"prefetch_window":["t_big"],"overall_budget":64} . capability_tag is a scope string, not a token.

maria: action items: devin -> proto + SDK helper for capability minting; liam -> implement weight-budget and telemetry; sasha -> capability-tag namespace and audit hooks; product (maria) -> choose defaults for overall_budget and prefetch heuristics. target: prototype next sprint.

ops-bot: ticket created CONSOLE-1298: "hybrid dashboard render-plan + budget prototype" (assignee: devin).

devin: i'll add a short failure-modes section in the RFC and a curl example for capability exchange.

liam: i'll run a replay harness on sampled dashboards to estimate server-assembled cost and share results.

sasha: will run privacy review once capability tagging is defined.

maria: thanks all, we'll update the RFC follow-up doc and track CONSOLE-1298. :rocket:
